title: Ipsos Global Trends - Technowonder
discussion_signal: The discussion presents technology as a simultaneous source of wonder and worry, linking innovation to concerns that it may have gone too far and to the need to rebuild consumer trust.
linked_research_question: How do technology unease, social fracture, nostalgia, individualism, and uncertainty reshape cultural and consumer meaning?
limits: The post is a high-level trend interpretation rather than a detailed public-opinion record
It does not establish which technologies drive the attitudes
Brand-facing framing may understate political and distributional conflict
